evidence.title: FinderGit — Native macOS File Browser with Git Intelligence

name: FinderGit
summary: Native macOS file browser that shows branch, status and diffs for all your Git repositories in one window.
description: A macOS 15+ app that combines file browsing with Git intelligence: a sortable repository portfolio with live branch, clean/dirty and ahead/behind state, an inline diff viewer, staging, commit, push and branch actions, a GitHub profile dashboard, AI commit messages, and disk-space maintenance. Free; published by Undolog (Giovambattista Fazioli).
contains: repository portfolio with live branch, clean/dirty and ahead/behind status
inline diff viewer with line numbers
stage, commit, push, pull and branch actions in-app
GitHub profile dashboard with a year of contributions as heatmap or line graph
AI commit messages from the staged diff, no API key
free, macOS 15+, universal, signed and notarized
